RaggieSoft Training Studio v0.7.0 • Visual IDE, .pptx Importer & SCORM / xAPI / cmi5 Compiler

Bandwidth-Proof WCAG 2.2 AA Compliance Courseware — Zero 400 MB MP4 Stalls.

Born from rescuing a 14-slide municipal ADA Title II training module that baked static slides into 400+ MB progressive .mp4 files and stalled across congested enterprise WAN proxies, RaggieSoft Training Studio v0.7.0 (TrainingStudio.exe & rstbuild) migrates Microsoft PowerPoint (.pptx) decks or compiles Git-diffable .rstp manifests, Markdown slides, Question Banks, Role Branching, RaggieScript, compact 48 kbps Opus/AAC voiceovers, and verified .vtt captions into SCORM 1.2, SCORM 2004 (4th Ed.), xAPI (Tin Can), and cmi5 packages (49.80 KB < 50 KB player) with an automatic HTML5 VPAT 2.5 report in the box.

New in RaggieSoft Training Studio v0.7.0 • Windows 11 Native x64 & ARM64

Six Major Capabilities Shipped in v0.7.0

1. Turnkey PowerPoint (.pptx) & Legacy SCORM Importer

Press Ctrl+I in TrainingStudio.exe or run rstbuild import-pptx deck.pptx ./course. Extracts OpenXML slide order, headings, bullets, cNvPr/@descr image alt-text, and speaker notes—converting speaker notes directly into verified <= 22 CPS WebVTT .vtt captions!

2. Side-by-Side Split Live Slide & CPS Preview

Author Markdown slides, .rstp manifests, and .vtt caption files on the left while inspecting live rendered callouts, remediation branch routes, and per-cue Characters-Per-Second (CPS) reading speeds on the right in real time.

3. Randomized Question Banks & Choice Shuffling

Declare [QuestionBank.<Id>] pools with DrawCount and ShuffleChoices = true. Uses a deterministic PRNG seed stored compactly inside cmi.suspend_data so cold LMS restarts preserve the exact drawn assessment subset under SCORM 1.2's 4,096-byte limit.

4. Role-Based Tracks & Remediation Branching

Define [Track.frontline] vs. [Track.supervisor] role paths inside one package and route missed scenario choices directly to targeted review slides via - [ ] a -> 01-foundations | Choice.

5. CSP-Safe RaggieScript (use training;)

Attach custom scoring and scenario rubrics via RaggieScriptSource—type-checked at compile time by RaggieScript.Core and transpiled into 100% eval()-free ES2022 JavaScript (RST030).

6. Quad-Standard LMS Output (49.80 KB Runtime)

Press F6 or pass --scorm=all to emit SCORM 1.2, SCORM 2004 4th Ed., xAPI (Tin Can) (tincan.xml), and cmi5 (cmi5.xml) alongside a tailored HTML5 VPAT 2.5 conformance report.

Public Engineering Roadmap • From v0.1 PoC to Suite-Wide v1.0 GA

RaggieSoft Training Studio Roadmap (v0.7.0 → v1.0.0 GA)

Every milestone keeps our learner runtime strictly < 50 KB uncompressed while maintaining permanent 100% Community == Architect feature parity. Read the raw Markdown specification at /training-studio/ROADMAP.md.

Shipped • v0.7.0 Current Release

PowerPoint Migration, Split Preview, Question Banks & xAPI / cmi5

Zero-dependency OpenXML .pptx & legacy SCORM migration importers, side-by-side Split Live Slide & Caption CPS Preview, pooled [QuestionBank.*] assessments with deterministic PRNG seeds, [Track.*] role routing, CSP-safe RaggieScript (use training;), and quad-standard SCORM 1.2 / 2004 / xAPI / cmi5 export.

Next Milestone • v0.8.0

Visual Audio Waveform, In-IDE Voiceover Recorder & Cue Stamper

Record per-slide narration directly inside TrainingStudio.exe via native WASAPI with automatic -16 LUFS loudness normalization, scrub visual Opus/WAV waveforms, and press Spacebar while listening to stamp exact MM:SS.mmm timestamps into .vtt cues and :::cue callouts.

Planned • v0.9.0

Multi-Language Track Switcher & SHA-256 Completion Receipt

Zero-reload learner language toggle (en-US, es-US, fr-CA) swapping localized Markdown, .vtt captions, and audio mid-slide, plus an offline-printable HTML5 Employee Completion Receipt stamped with a deterministic SHA-256 verification digest.

Planned • v1.0.0 GA

Tagged PDF/UA-1 VPATs, XLIFF 2.1 Sync & Unified Suite 1.0

Direct pipeline integration with Document Studio (emitting Matterhorn-verified Tagged PDF/UA-1 VPAT 2.5 procurement packets), Localization Studio (round-trip XLIFF 2.1 caption translation with CPS expansion guards), and Unified 8-Tool Suite 1.0 orchestration.
